sources.title: Stable Audio 3.0 | Generative Audio Models — Stability AI
sources.snippet: Learn about Stable Audio 3.0, a model family trained on fully licensed data, designed to be the foundation for what the audio community builds next. Three of the models are open weights, free to download and build on.

sources.title: Introducing Stable Audio 3 & SAME (Semantically-Aligned Music ...
sources.snippet: Introducing Stable Audio 3 & SAME (semantically-aligned music autoencoder). Stable Audio 3 is a family of fast latent diffusion models (small, medium, large) for variable-length audio generation and editing.
